clips.prompt: A painterly historical illustration in motion, wide landscape composition, an imaginary ancient Egyptian processional avenue lined on both sides with rows of recumbent sphinx statues extending far into the distance toward a simple stone temple. Gentle oblique dawn light, muted ochre stone and blue shadows, visible brushwork, quiet and contemplative. The camera makes an extremely slow steady forward drift. Keep every statue distant; never approach or show any face in close-up. No humans, no portraits of actual kings or queens, no hieroglyphs or readable writing, no modern buildings, no tourists. This is an evocative fictional setting, not an exact archaeological reconstruction. Stable geometry, no morphing, no flicker, no sudden changes, no cuts, no camera shake.

Painterly myth illustration in motion, an empty rocky hillside at dusk in ancient Greece. A small ancient walled town is visible far below at the foot of the hill. A large soft shadow of wings glides slowly across the foreground rock, cast by something entirely outside the frame. Show ONLY the shadow, never the creature that casts it, never a face or a person. The camera barely drifts sideways, with steady movement and fixed warm dusk lighting. Visible brushwork, muted earth colors and blue violet shadows, clearly a painting rather than an archival photograph. No attack, no falling creature, no violence, no readable text, no modern architecture, no tourists. Stable rocks and town, no morphing, no flicker, no cuts.

Painterly desert landscape in motion at sunset, a very distant recumbent Great Sphinx silhouette and a pyramid at the edge of the desert, backlit against a dim amber horizon, deep blue violet foreground sand. The sphinx is a small dark silhouette with no visible facial details. No people. Slow, continuous, almost imperceptible sideways camera drift, steady atmosphere, quiet contemplative closing shot. Visible fine brushwork, distinguishable from a historic photograph. No modern buildings, no tourists, no writing, no hieroglyphs, no readable text. No close-up, no identifiable human portrait, no morphing, no flicker, no sudden lighting changes, no cuts.

An animated hand-painted oil painting on visibly textured canvas, NOT a photograph, NOT a 3D render. Ancient Greek rocky hillside at dusk, seen from a high downward-looking camera. The foreground is one broad flat pale rock slab filling the lower three quarters of the image. A tiny ancient walled town is far below in the upper left background. Only a narrow strip of clear amber sky at the very top. A soft dark silhouette of two outstretched wings moves slowly across THE SURFACE OF THE FOREGROUND ROCK ONLY, conforming to the rock texture like a real cast shadow. The shadow never enters the sky, never floats, never becomes a solid object. The creature casting it remains completely outside the frame. The entire sky stays clear and empty. Thick visible brush strokes, matte ochre and violet painted forms, simplified illustrative details. Locked camera, constant light, one slow steady shadow movement. No humans, faces, birds, creatures, writing, modern buildings, attacks, falls, flickering or cuts.

Animated 2D gouache painting, strong visible dry-brush strokes on rough paper, flattened hand-painted shapes, matte colors. A very wide view of an imaginary ancient Egyptian temple approach at dawn. Tiny recumbent sphinx statues line both sides of a long sandy avenue. Every statue is distant, each head is only a tiny unpainted shape with absolutely no facial detail. No foreground statues: the nearest complete statue occupies less than five percent of image width. All plinths are plain blank stone with no inscriptions. Warm diagonal dawn sunlight, muted ochre, dusty blue shadows. The statues and architecture remain perfectly rigid and still, facing fixed directions. Only an extremely slow gentle forward camera drift, like a painted documentary background. Clearly a handmade painting, never a photograph or realistic 3D render. No humans, identifiable royal portraits, text, hieroglyphs, tourists or modern buildings. No turning heads, moving statues, morphing, flicker, cuts or camera shake.
